content: .{@-मुखः, -मुखम्@} [गोर्मुखमिव मुखमस्य] a kind of musical instrument; <ls>Bg. 1. 13</ls>; गोमुखानां च शृङ्गाणामनीकद्वयवर्तिनाम् <ls>Śiva B. 24. 55</ls>. . ({@-खः@}) .²1 a crocodile, shark. .²2 a hole of a particular shape in a wall made by thieves. ({@-खम्@}) .²1 a house built unevenly. .²2 spreading unguents, smearing; ‘गोमुखं कुटिलाकारे वाद्यभाण्डे विलेपने’ इति विश्वः; यस्यामलिन्देषु न चकुरेव मुग्धाङ्गना गोमयगोमुखानि <ls>Śi. 3. 48</ls>. . ({@-खम्, -खी@}) a cloth-bag of the shape of a gnomon containing a rosary, the beads of which are counted by the hand thrust inside. .²2 a house built unevenly. .²3 a particular method of sitting (a योगासन) ({@-खी@}) the chasm in the Himālaya mountains through which the Ganges flows.
